jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Grid Software
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

Want to help build the future of energy? At GE Vernova, our grid software helps keep the lights on and the world moving forward. As a Grid Software Project Manager, you'll lead the way, turning customer promises into powerful, real-world solutions that shape a more reliable, sustainable grid.

The Grid Software Project Manager is the pathfinder for the customer, translating customer and business commitments into disciplined execution and measurable outcomes. This role leads customer-facing software solution projects from initiation through acceptance and transition, coordinating customers, delivery teams, partners, and supporting functions. The Project Manager owns delivery across scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, governance, customer value, and project financial health.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

Customer and stakeholder leadership. Serve as the primary delivery contact; align expectations, communicate proactively, balance competing needs, and connect decisions to customer outcomes, confidence, adoption, and value.
Scope and change control. Define objectives, requirements, deliverables, work breakdown structure, acceptance criteria, assumptions, and responsibilities. Baseline scope and manage changes through documented impact assessment and approval.
Integrated schedule management. Build and actively manage milestones, dependencies, critical path, customer obligations, and internal handoffs. Maintain a current schedule, identify variance early, and drive recovery actions.
Financial and commercial management. Own cost, margin, forecast accuracy, cash flow, billing readiness, and commercial exposure. Understand contractual obligations, identify entitlement, manage change orders, and protect project profitability.
Customer value realization and account growth. Identify opportunities to expand customer value, solution adoption, and project scope; partner with commercial and account teams to develop appropriate growth opportunities while maintaining delivery and contractual discipline.
Risk, issue, and decision management. Maintain a current RAID log with clear owners and due dates. Anticipate risks, lead mitigation and structured problem solving, and escalate with facts, options, and recommendations.
Governance and reporting. Establish operating mechanisms and decision rights. Provide accurate, timely, decision-useful status, forecasts, performance data, and executive updates. Maintain complete project records.
Cross-functional delivery leadership. Lead matrixed teams across software development, engineering, product, quality, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, services, finance, commercial, sales, and partners as applicable. Clarify accountability and drive commitments to closure.
Quality, acceptance, and transition. Integrate quality planning, coordinate testing and defect resolution, maintain traceability to acceptance criteria, and support-controlled implementation and transition to customer operations
and support.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
10+ years of project management experience for Senior-level customer-facing requisitions, including customer-facing software, technology, systems integration, or solution delivery projects.
Demonstrated experience managing scope, integrated schedules, financials, risks and issues, change control, quality, governance, and executive reporting.
Experience leading cross-functional, matrixed teams and managing customers and internal stakeholders through complex delivery situations.
Strong communication, analysis, negotiation, problem-solving, and decision-making skills across technical, commercial, operational, and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering electric utility software, including control-room or mission-critical operational solutions.
Knowledge of utility operations and grid applications such as SCADA, energy management, advanced distribution management, or outage management.
Commercial and contract management experience, including customer acceptance, change orders, margin protection, billing, and cash flow.
Experience with global, distributed teams, implementation partners, and multi-region delivery.
Working knowledge of software delivery lifecycles and Agile, Scrum, hybrid, and Waterfall approaches.
PMP, PMI-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster, or comparable certification; master’s degree in a relevant field.

For candidates applying to a Canadian-based position, the pay range for this position is between $130,400.00 - $195,600.00 CAD. The specific pay offered may be influenced by a variety of factors, including the candidate’s experience, education, and skill set.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Quantum Computing Applied Research
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can develop a lasting impact on the world.

Quantum computing is accelerating from lab to utility, and NVIDIA sits at the center of that shift. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact strategic R&D initiatives within quantum computing. You will lead across our applied research R&D roadmap to craft clarity and success. We are innovating groundbreaking techniques for quantum in AI and accelerated computing, so that useful fault-tolerant quantum computing arrives sooner. Partner across engineering, applied research, and product teams inside NVIDIA, and with external collaborators, you will build and operationalize innovation roadmaps that pioneer ahead. Success in this role includes outstanding program leadership, communication, and problem solving. If you're passionate about bringing quantum computing into the fault-tolerant era with accelerated computing, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

Initiate and lead multiple concurrent technical programs across our quantum computing portfolio, with emphasis on bringing the full power of accelerated computing to the field.
Define clear execution plans and measurable outcomes from our R&D and technology roadmaps, then lown the work to success across teams.
Identify & prioritize the most critical activities required for the research's success, and ensure that they are completed.
Develop a strong technical understanding of our R&D priorities, to enable successful collaborations, and proactively identify new opportunities.
Creatively solve and mitigate technical challenges, while establishing early risk identification and mitigations.
Serve as a link between research and engineering, moving new technologies from incubation to scalable solutions.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
10+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives, including multiple sophisticated programs at once and execution alongside research, engineering, and technical leadership.
Validated understanding of the quantum computing ecosystem and technologies, including hardware and software.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate sophisticated technical concepts for a range of audiences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Advanced degree (MS or PhD or equivalent) in quantum information science, physics, or a closely related field, or hands-on research or engineering experience inside a quantum program.
Background in translating research output to developed technology.
Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, HPC environments, or hybrid quantum-classical workflows and the tooling around them.
Experience running joint technical programs with national laboratories, companies, universities, or research institutions.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

168,000 USD – 258,750 USD for Level 4; and 200,000 USD – 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

As an IT Project Manager, you'll take projects from planning through completion, working closely with IT professionals, business leaders, outside vendors, and other teams throughout UPPCO. You'll keep projects moving forward, manage budgets and timelines, solve problems along the way, and help turn technology plans into successful results. If you’re someone who enjoys bringing people together, staying organized, and seeing projects through from beginning to end, this may be a great fit for you.

What We Offer.

Very competitive salary based on your knowledge and experience.
Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
401(k) retirement plan with up to a 5% company match.
Additional insurances at no cost to you: short and long-term disability, medical emergency transport, basic life, accidental death & dismemberment, and employee assistance.
Generous paid time off and nine paid holidays.
The opportunity to make an impact in a respected, community-minded utility organization.

What Your Days Look Like.

Lead IT Projects. Manage multiple technology projects from initial planning through implementation and completion, keeping work on schedule, within budget, and aligned with project goals.
Build Project Plans. Define project goals, scope, timelines, milestones, budgets, staffing needs, and expected results.
Keep Projects on Track. Monitor progress, manage competing priorities, identify potential delays, and make adjustments to keep projects moving forward.
Manage Budgets & Resources. Develop cost estimates, track spending, forecast project expenses, and coordinate the people and resources needed for success.
Solve Problems & Manage Risks. Identify potential challenges, evaluate options, and work with others to find practical solutions.
Bring Teams Together. Lead and coordinate project teams, working closely with departments throughout UPPCO, contractors, vendors, and other business partners.
Communicate Project Progress. Provide clear, timely updates to leadership and project stakeholders on schedules, budgets, accomplishments, and potential concerns.
Support Quality & Change Management. Help ensure projects meet established quality standards and follow IT change management processes, including ITIL practices.
Promote Safety & Security. Support UPPCO's commitment to workplace safety, cybersecurity, and protecting company information and systems.

What We Are Looking For.

Bachelor’s degree in I.T., Computer Science, Cybersecurity or a related field is required.
4 or more years of experience managing IT-related projects required.
Certification as an Associate In Project Management (CAPM) or Certified Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred.
Good understanding of IT systems, technology, and project management practices.
Experience managing project budgets, schedules, resources, and deadlines.
Comfortable using PM tools such as Microsoft Project, Gantt charts, dashboards, and Microsoft Office.
Ability to bring people and teams together, work well with others, and communicate clearly.
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to adapt to changing priorities.
Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and takes pride in delivering quality work.
Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel within UPPCO’s service territory (up to 20%) required.

ARE YOU READY
to join an organization that powers Michigan’s Upper Peninsula with integrity, innovation, and care? Apply today at uppco.hirescore.com

—————————————-

UPPCO is a regulated electric utility delivering safe, reliable energy to about 54,000 customers in 10 counties of Michigan's pristine Upper Peninsula. Our assets include 7 hydroelectric renewable energy generation facilities that also offer public recreational opportunities on land and water, 2 combustion turbines providing a total generation capacity of approximately 80 megawatts, 3,300 miles of electric distribution lines, and 58 distribution substations.

Manage multiple wireless infrastructure deployment projects simultaneously from initiation through pre-construction completion.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Akima Data Management is seeking a highly qualified Program Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team supporting mission-critical cybersecurity, information technology, and operational services. This position requires a hands-on leader who will be onsite full-time, providing direct supervision, guidance, and operational oversight to ensure all contract requirements are met with the highest standards of quality, performance, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Lead contract execution, workforce planning, staffing, quality assurance, budget tracking, operational reporting, and stakeholder engagement to ensure successful program delivery.
Direct the development and maintenance of cybersecurity strategies, plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), performance metrics and executive dashboards.
Manage Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities, Assessment and Authorization (A&A/CATO) processes, FISMA compliance, NIST control implementation, audit support, and POA&M remediation efforts.
Oversee enterprise risk management activities, including risk register maintenance, cybersecurity assessments, scorecards, incident reporting, and risk mitigation planning.
Coordinate and evaluate penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and red, blue, and purple team exercises to strengthen security posture.
Provide leadership for Zero Trust initiatives, IPv6 transition efforts, enterprise security architecture, and cybersecurity engineering teams.
Guide cloud security strategy and architecture across Azure and Microsoft 365 environments, ensuring compliance with federal cybersecurity requirements and best practices.
Manage vulnerability scanning, remediation programs, IAVM compliance activities, and cybersecurity compliance reporting.
Oversee the implementation and operation of security technologies, including firewalls, secure web gateways (SWG), endpoint protection platforms, antivirus solutions, and Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems.
Direct Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, including incident response, digital forensics, threat monitoring, investigation, and executive reporting.
Manage Identity, Credential, and Access Management (ICAM) programs, including authentication, authorization, privileged access, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) services.
Lead disaster recovery (DR) and continuity of operations (COOP) planning, testing, exercises, and recovery operations to ensure mission resilience.
Establish and monitor service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), operational metrics, and performance reporting to support continuous service improvement.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Singularity is an aerospace and defense startup headquartered in Gardena, CA. Our founding team hails from SpaceX, Anduril, and Lockheed Martin, and we are backed by Joint Staff-level military leadership and several Silicon Valley firms. Our first product is a low-cost air defense system built for immediate deployment worldwide. With a world-class business development and leadership team already in place, we are well positioned to capitalize on already overwhelming demand.

About The Role

We are looking for a Program Manager to help lead execution of fast-paced U.S. military and FMS programs involving tactical counter-air, integrated fires, and command-and-control integration. Reporting to the Director of Program Management, you will own the day-to-day program controls that turn contract scope, technical baselines, test plans, customer commitments, and business priorities into an executable plan. The position will be primarily aligned to U.S military programs while retaining the flexibility to support other FMS programs as they are awarded. This is a hands-on role for a disciplined leader who can manage cost, schedule, risk, deliverables, and cross-functional execution across multiple efforts without losing focus on the primary customer’s mission.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Controls

Integrated Program Execution: Translate contracts, Other Transaction Authority agreements, Statements of Work, milestones, and technical requirements into an integrated master schedule, work breakdown structure, deliverable register, and near-term resource plan.
Cost, Schedule, & Risk: Maintain program execution baselines, track actuals and forecasts, identify cost and schedule variance, and drive mitigation or recovery plans before issues affect customer commitments.
Milestone Management: Plan and coordinate program reviews, payable milestone evidence, entrance and exit criteria, action closure, and Government acceptance packages.
Decision Discipline: Maintain decision, action, assumption, dependency, and risk registers so every major issue has an owner, due date, and documented impact to the baseline.
Multi-Program Support: Prioritize assigned programs while applying scalable program-management processes to other awarded efforts based on company needs and leadership direction.

Cross-Functional Integration

Integrated Product Team Leadership: Coordinate engineering, test, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, contracts, finance, configuration management, logistics, and business operations across a deliverable-based IPT structure.
Technical & Test Alignment: Partner with engineering and test leadership to keep requirements, interfaces, design maturity, manufacturing readiness, range planning, safety, verification evidence, and schedule synchronized.
C2 & System Integration Coordination: Support planning and execution for sensor, command-and-control, fire-control, launcher, interceptor, tactical data link, and external network interfaces, including Government and industry dependencies.
Supplier & Subcontractor Execution: Support subcontract planning, statements of work, purchase priorities, delivery tracking, and recovery actions for critical hardware, software, and services.
Configuration & Deliverable Control: Ensure baseline changes, customer direction, technical data, and contract artifacts are captured, reviewed, approved, and traceable.

Customer & Contract Interface

Customer Coordination: Serve as a principal day-to-day program interface with customer program, technical, contracting, test, range, and operational stakeholders; prepare clear status, decision, and issue packages.
Additional Program Support: Build and maintain credibility with other Government stakeholders when assigned to support active or newly awarded programs.
Contract Execution: Work with contracts, finance, and technical leads to align execution with contract terms, milestones, data rights, reporting requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Government Dependencies: Track Government-furnished information, equipment, facilities, range access, platform or network interfaces, approvals, and other dependencies required for execution and testing.
Executive Reporting: Provide concise, decision-ready updates covering progress, forecast, risks, financial status, dependencies, and recommended actions.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience managing complex defense, aerospace, missile, integrated fires, command-and-control, autonomy, maritime, or similarly hardware-intensive development programs
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, program management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
Experience managing cost, schedule, risk, requirements, deliverables, and cross-functional execution on a U.S. Department of War contract or prototype effort
Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrated master schedules, work breakdown structures, risk registers, program review materials, and executive-level status reporting
Experience coordinating engineering development, hardware manufacturing, software integration, test planning, and supplier execution within an aggressive schedule
Working knowledge of Department of War acquisition and contracting processes, including Statements of Work, CDRLs or equivalent deliverables, Government-furnished property or information, and formal review gates
Ability to convert ambiguous customer objectives into clear work packages, accountable owners, measurable completion criteria, and executable near-term priorities
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior Government, military, and company leaders with clarity and credibility
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance as required
Ability to travel approximately 15% to customer sites, integration facilities, suppliers, military ranges, and test events as program execution requires

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong adjacent program-management and system-integration experience are encouraged to apply.

Direct experience supporting U.S Military Program Executive Offices or Project Management Office, particularly PAE Fires or Missile Defense Agency
Familiarity with the PAE Fires portfolio and the Army integrated fires enterprise, including engagement with PAE Fires or related program, engineering, and integration organizations
Working knowledge of Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS), Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), or comparable joint or service command-and-control and fire-control architectures
Experience coordinating C2 integration involving sensors, tactical data links, engagement planning, fire-control functions, launchers, interceptors, or external networks
Understanding of Army air defense, counter-unmanned aircraft systems, indirect fire protection, or integrated fires mission areas
Experience with Army or joint test organizations, operational demonstrations, range coordination, safety approvals, and verification or acceptance evidence
Experience executing prototype Other Transaction Authority agreements, including payable milestones, evidence packages, modifications, and Government acceptance
Experience managing concurrent development, qualification, manufacturing, software integration, ground test, flight test, and demonstration activities
Experience with configuration management, earned value or equivalent performance measurement, supply-chain risk, and production readiness
Direct experience as a Deputy Program Manager, Program Manager, IPT Lead, or Program Controls Lead in a defense environment
PMP, DAWIA, or equivalent program-management or acquisition certification
Active or recently active U.S. Secret clearance or higher
Experience supporting a non-traditional defense contractor or high-growth defense technology company

Compensation

Salary: $175,000 – $225,000

jobs.title: Senior Software Technical Program Manager, CUDA Robotics
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking an experienced Senior Software Technical Program Manager to lead sophisticated software and platform programs spanning NVIDIA CUDA Robotics, accelerated computing and Physical AI! You will translate product and technology roadmaps into executable plans, establish achievements and ownership, lead multi-functional dependencies and risks, and drive programs from development through integration, validation, release, and ecosystem adoption. You will work across Product Management, Software and Hardware Engineering, Research, Quality Assurance, DevRel, Marketing, Legal, Customer Program Management, Solution Architects and external partners!

What You Will Be Doing

Collaborating closely with Software Development Managers, Engineers, Product Marketing, Customer Program Management, Solution Architects, Quality Assurance, and other logistics personnel to establish and implement streamlined processes for the development of advanced Compute software solutions for CSPs, OEMs, customers and partners.
Taking the lead in Physical AI initiatives involving CUDA software, Aerial software, GPU platforms, AI frameworks, inference, simulation, sensor processing, and developer ecosystems.
Scheduling and leading status meetings, proactively addressing challenges, addressing customer concerns, and serving as the central point of contact for building and upholding release schedules and the prioritized release plan of record.
Partnering with multi-functional teams throughout the company to strategically plan and drive software objectives for the team. In this role, you will collect requirements, help define priorities, remove blockers, drive planning and scheduling for all phases of the software development lifecycle.
Developing and maintaining integrated plans across multiple engineering workstreams, identifying critical-path dependencies, proactively identifying risks and formulating risk management strategies and driving teams toward commitments.
Taking the lead in enhancing existing product development and software release processes, while collaborating with engineering management to optimize the development workflow for maximum engineering efficiency. You will have the opportunity to partner with diverse technical groups, spanning all organizational levels.
Internally translating customer requirements into actionable tasks, ensuring customers are continually abreast about issue statuses. Drive Virtual reviews and establish a close feedback loop by communicating benchmarking results and customer insights to product and engineering leadership.
Collaborating with various internal teams and third-party partners across different time zones, as necessary, to resolve customer issues and supervise customer releases. Track and report large-scale performance benchmarking across all clusters. Build performance dashboards and reporting processes to monitor critical metrics and surface performance trends.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of proven experience in technical program management, software engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical role.
Hands on experience with software development for hardware platforms or communication runtime or high performance networking with demonstrated success in delivering complex products to customers.
Proficiency in Agile software development methodologies and tools.
Ability to work independently and actively with minimal guidance.
Confirmed experience to creatively resolve technical and resource issues. Ability to think strategically and tactically and to build consensus to ensure program success
Comprehensive understanding of software engineering principles, including experience with widely-adopted configuration management tools and productivity-enhancing tools and automation processes.
Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated capacity for multitasking, in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements.
Proven ability to resolve technical, schedule, resource, and organizational issues through influence and structured decision-making.
Strong communication and technical presentation skills.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Background with NVIDIA CUDA, Aerial, AI-RAN, 5G/6G, software-defined RAN, accelerated networking, or telecom platforms.
Experience with GPU-accelerated software, AI/ML frameworks, or NVIDIA GPU platforms, including familiarity with Physical AI, autonomous systems, simulation, perception, inference, or multimodal sensor pipelines.
Experience delivering SDKs, reference architectures, developer platforms, datasets, simulation environments, or digital twins.
Experience leading customer and partner programs involving platform bring-up, proof-of-concepts, benchmarking, and production releases.
MBA/PMP certification or training is a plus.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

168,000 USD – 258,750 USD for Level 4; and 200,000 USD – 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 13, 2026.

jobs.title: Program Security Manager
jobs.description:
Who We Are

GITAI is a vertically integrated space and defense company building the next generation of hardware for low-Earth-orbit missions.

At our core is the space robotics technology that has defined GITAI from the beginning. A small, highly capable engineering team applies that foundation across satellite buses, in-orbit servicing robotics, and mission hardware for applications such as Earth observation. Today, a major focus of our work is supporting U.S. national security missions, particularly through proliferated LEO satellite constellations and other next-generation space systems.

We design, build, integrate, and test much of our hardware in-house. Electrical, mechanical, software, manufacturing, integration, and test teams work closely together, allowing a small team to own complete systems rather than isolated components. This vertical integration helps us move quickly, learn directly from hardware, and shorten the path from architecture to a working system.

We are still early. The systems, the company, and the market are all being built at the same time. Requirements change, technical problems are often ambiguous, and many answers do not yet exist. We are looking for exceptional engineers and operators who want broad ownership, can work across disciplines, and are willing to stay close to the hardware until the mission succeeds.

About The Role

We are looking for a Program Security Manager to turn Government-approved Security Classification Guides (SCGs), DD Forms 254, and related guidance into clear, practical rules for technical work. You will work directly with Mechanical, Electrical, Software, and Systems Engineering leaders to apply classification requirements to designs, CAD, circuits, firmware, source code, analyses, and test data, and resolve unclear cases with authorized Government representatives. You will also coordinate reviews of Lawful Permanent Resident (LPR) contributions under our Quality Management Plan (QMP) with qualified designated technical reviewers. Hands-on software engineering experience and technical classification-management expertise are essential.

This role reports to the Senior Management Official (SMO), with day-to-day priorities coordinated with the VP of Legal and VP of Program Management. You will work closely with Engineering, the Facility Security Officer (FSO), Quality, IT/Cybersecurity, Contracts, and Export Compliance.

Key Responsibilities

Security Classification & Engineering Integration

Lead the interpretation and application of Government-issued SCGs, DD Forms 254, and other approved classification guidance to GITAI’s technical work. Maintain internal guidance traceable to those sources.
Partner with engineering leaders to assess what information is disclosed by designs, software, interfaces, specifications, simulations, manufacturing data, and test results; establish appropriate classification, markings, handling, and segregation requirements.
Participate in technical and design reviews to identify classification questions early, including issues involving aggregation, compilation, release, and transfer of technical information.
Coordinate unresolved classification questions with the Government Program Security Officer (PSO) or other authorized Government representatives. Document guidance, decisions, and follow-up actions.
Build simple, repeatable workflows for classified and unclassified data that let engineers move quickly while meeting classification, access-control, marking, and pre-release review requirements. Prevent information spills and train personnel on their responsibilities.

QMP Review of LPR Contributions

Coordinate implementation of the QMP “Quality Review of LPR Contributions” process for covered software, firmware, scripts, configuration and build files, hardware and circuit designs, programmable logic, drawings, specifications, analyses, test results, and related components.
Work with the SMO and Engineering to ensure reviews are carried out by appropriately cleared U.S. citizen employees with need-to-know, relevant technical competence, and written designation by the SMO.
Coordinate the use of SMO-approved review procedures and tools addressing technical accuracy, contract conformance, unauthorized functionality, and confirmation that contributions are unclassified and prepared without access to classified information.
Work with designated technical reviewers and IT/Engineering on source-code review, static and software-composition analysis, testing, configuration control, build integrity, and documented acceptance before contributions enter the Program baseline.
Ensure reviews remain independent of LPR direction or approval, that review standards and tools are SMO-approved, and that feedback to LPR personnel remains unclassified. Coordinate with Engineering and IT to protect the Program baseline and build environment as required by the QMP.
Ensure review findings, author attribution, corrective actions, and acceptance records are captured; coordinate security concerns or suspected classified content promptly with the FSO and SMO. The FSO retains oversight of record retention and required reporting.
Personally conduct software-related technical reviews only when technically qualified and formally designated. Mechanical, electrical, and other domain-specific technical reviews remain with suitably qualified designated reviewers.

Security Program Framework & Compliance

Work with the FSO, Legal, Engineering, Quality, and IT/Cybersecurity to implement relevant classified-information, CUI, technology-control, and FOCI mitigation procedures, including applicable QMP, AOP, TCP, and ECP requirements.
Support DCSA and Government security reviews, internal training, incident-response coordination, and ongoing improvements to classification and technical-information protection procedures.
Support program and stakeholder coordination as needed, without primary ownership of program cost, schedule, or portfolio delivery.

Classification activities must follow applicable U.S. Government classification authority and guidance. This position does not confer Original Classification Authority or permit independent classification decisions outside authorized derivative classification procedures.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another closely related STEM field.
Hands-on professional experience in software engineering, including developing, integrating, or reviewing software, embedded software, or firmware.
Demonstrated experience interpreting and applying U.S. Government Security Classification Guides (SCGs) to engineering data, such as source code, hardware designs, technical specifications, or test results, in classified U.S. Government or DoD programs.
Experience working directly with engineering teams and Government security representatives to resolve technical classification questions.
Working knowledge of DD Form 254, NISP, classified information, and CUI requirements, with experience developing practical security procedures, training, and auditable processes.
Professional experience at a venture capital-backed startup, regardless of funding stage. Past or current employment qualifies.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in spacecraft, satellites, defense systems, missile defense, sensors, robotics, or complex hardware/software development.
Experience building or improving classification and technical-information security processes at an aerospace or defense startup.
Experience administering FOCI mitigation requirements, Quality Management Plans, or independent reviews of engineering contributions.
Experience with code review, secure development and build processes, static code analysis, software composition analysis, configuration management, or technical integrity testing.
Background as a Program Security Manager, CPSO, Classification Management Specialist, Industrial Security Specialist, or comparable role.
Broader program management, Government customer coordination, and cross-functional stakeholder management experience.

Security Clearance & Export-Control Requirements

Must be a U.S. citizen and eligible to obtain and maintain the U.S. Government security clearance required for the Program.
Active Secret clearance or higher strongly preferred given near-term classified program requirements.
Must be able to comply with all requirements applicable to classified information, CUI, and export-controlled technical data. QMP Designated Reviewer duties, if assigned, also require the applicable clearance, need-to-know, technical competence, and written SMO designation.

Location & Employment Details

Torrance, CA / Full-time, Exempt
This is a full-time onsite role based at GITAI’s office in Torrance, CA. This position requires working onsite five days per week. Remote or hybrid work is not expected for this role.

jobs.title: SAP Project Manager
jobs.description:
SAP Project / Program Manager

Paris and Toulouse, France

Permanent

Job Description

Are you an experienced SAP S/4HANA Project / Program Manager with a strong track record of shaping and successfully delivering complex transformation projects?
We are looking for a hands-on SAP S/4HANA Project Manager who can take ownership from initial project shaping and scoping through mobilization, planning, Fit-to-Standard, execution, testing, data migration, cutover and stabilization.
The role requires strong practical knowledge of SAP Activate, Fit-to-Standard and Agile / SAFe ways of working, combined with the ability to establish an effective delivery methodology, create and manage detailed integrated project plans, orchestrate multiple SAP workstreams, establish robust governance and bring business and IT stakeholders together around common project outcomes.
In addition to delivery leadership, the Project Manager will play an important role in project shaping, proposals and pre-sales, preparation of customer offers, scope and change management and commercial tracking.
Key Responsibilities

1. Project Shaping, Scoping & Roadmap

Shape the SAP S/4HANA project roadmap, translating business and transformation objectives into a realistic and executable delivery approach.
Lead the effective scoping of SAP S/4HANA projects, defining scope boundaries, workstreams, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, timelines and resource requirements.
Structure projects into manageable work packages with clear ownership across business, functional, technical, integration, data, testing and change teams.
Facilitate scope alignment with business and IT stakeholders and establish a robust scope and delivery baseline.
Identify scope gaps, cross-stream dependencies and delivery risks early and drive them toward timely resolution.
Ensure that project commitments remain realistic and aligned with available capacity, business priorities and agreed outcomes.

2. Project Mobilization & Integrated Planning

Translate the project roadmap and scope into a detailed integrated project plan covering all major business, solution, development, integration, data, testing, change and technical activities.
Establish milestones, dependencies, critical paths, decision points, deliverables and resource requirements.
Define the project organization, roles and responsibilities, workstream structure, governance forums and ways of working.
Mobilize the project team and ensure clarity of objectives, scope, responsibilities, deliverables and expected outcomes.
Establish effective project controls for milestones, risks, issues, actions, dependencies and decisions.
Continuously monitor progress against the agreed baseline and proactively initiate corrective actions where required.

3. SAP Activate, Fit-to-Standard & Delivery Methodology

Establish and operationalize the project methodology based on SAP Activate, complemented by Agile and SAFe practices as appropriate.
Define project phases, deliverables, quality gates, governance mechanisms and working practices, ensuring that methodology supports delivery rather than becoming an administrative exercise.
Successfully anchor the preparation and planning of Fit-to-Standard workshops, ensuring appropriate workshop sequencing, business participation, prerequisites, process coverage and expected outcomes.
Guide workstreams in applying a consistent methodology for SAP Best Practices, process validation, requirements management, backlog creation and solution decisions.
Ensure workshop outputs are translated into clearly owned decisions, requirements, backlog items and actions.
Drive consistency of methodology and execution across functional and technical workstreams.

4. Business & Stakeholder Engagement

Establish a comprehensive stakeholder map across business, IT, process owners, key users, project teams and leadership.
Bring stakeholders onto a common transformation journey through effective project kickoffs, workshops, PI Planning, demonstrations, governance forums and regular communication.
Establish clarity around stakeholder roles, decision rights and expected business participation throughout the project.
Build strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and ensure transparency around progress, priorities, dependencies, decisions and risks.
Proactively manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate timely resolution of issues and competing priorities.

5. Backlog, Agile & Cross-Stream Management

Establish effective mechanisms for backlog management, prioritization, PI Planning, demos and decision-making.
Work closely with business stakeholders and workstream leads to continuously align and prioritize the backlog based on business value, project objectives, dependencies and delivery capacity.
Drive resolution of cross-stream topics where decisions in one functional or technical area impact other processes or workstreams.
Facilitate end-to-end thinking across business processes rather than allowing workstreams to operate independently.
Maintain transparency on open requirements, decisions, dependencies and delivery progress.

6. Project, Solution & Change Governance

Establish and operate an effective project governance model with clear responsibilities, decision rights and escalation mechanisms.
Set up and drive solution governance, change governance and Steering Committee governance.
Establish effective weekly and monthly operating cadences across project management, workstreams and leadership forums.
Drive regular project reviews focused on progress, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality and commercial performance.
Define and monitor meaningful project KPIs to enable objective, fact-based performance measurement.
Ensure transparent reporting and early identification and escalation of material deviations from plan.

7. Testing & Quality Management

Provide project leadership in establishing the overall testing strategy and framework, working closely with testing and functional teams.
Ensure effective planning and governance across integration testing, User Acceptance Testing, regression testing and defect management.
Drive the appropriate use of test automation with the support of specialist teams.
Ensure traceability and transparency between requirements, solution delivery, test scenarios, defects and business acceptance.
Monitor testing progress, quality and readiness as integral components of overall project governance.

8. Master Data, Migration & End-to-End Readiness

Provide the project management platform required to effectively drive master data and data migration topics.
Bring business, functional, data and technical stakeholders together around data ownership, quality, migration scope, dependencies and readiness.
Ensure data activities are integrated into the project plan rather than managed as stand-alone technical activities.
Drive visibility and resolution of cross-stream and end-to-end topics, particularly where process, solution, integration and data dependencies intersect.
Ensure integrated readiness across process, solution, data, integration, testing, change and cutover activities.

9. Commercial & Change Control

Maintain transparency of project commercials, including effort consumption, budget, forecast, staffing and financial performance against the agreed commercial baseline.
Establish disciplined scope and change control, ensuring deviations from the agreed baseline are identified early and assessed for impact.

Pour l'un de nos clients, une banque d'investissement de la place parisienne, nous recherchons un(e) Business Analyst spécialisé(e) sur les Produits Structurés.

Dans ce cadre, il/elle évoluera au sein des équipes Front Office, Structuring ou IT en interaction directe avec les équipes métiers, quantitatives et IT en :

* Recueillant et analysant les besoins des équipes Structuring, Trading, Sales et Risk autour des produits structurés,
* Traduisant les besoins métiers en spécifications fonctionnelles détaillées pour les plateformes de structuration, de pricing et de booking,

* Définissant les stratégies de tests, rédigeant les cas de tests et coordonnant les phases de recette (SIT, UAT),
* Analysant les écarts de valorisation, investiguant les anomalies de pricing ou de payoff et assurant le suivi des corrections.

* Diplômé(e) d'un Bac +5 spécialisation Finance de Marché, Ingénierie Financière ou Mathématiques Financières, vous disposez d’une expérience significative en Business Analyse sur des problématiques liées aux produits structurés.

* Vous avez une très bonne connaissance des sous-jacents (Equity, Indices, FX, Taux) ainsi que des paramètres de marché utilisés dans les modèles de valorisation (volatilité, taux d’intérêt, dividendes, corrélations).
* Vous comprenez les principaux modèles de pricing utilisés pour les produits dérivés (Black-Scholes, modèles de volatilité locale ou stochastique, Monte Carlo, arbres binomiaux).
* Vous êtes à l’aise avec les problématiques de modélisation des données, les architectures de systèmes Front-to-Risk et les outils de calcul de valorisation.
Vous maîtrisez parfaitement l'anglais et faites preuve de rigueur, d’un fort esprit analytique et d’une capacité à évoluer dans des environnements exigeants et fortement techniques.

The Senior Project Manager position is expected to manage all aspects of a project to meet customer expectations and maintain a high level of quality through communication, customer service, and organizational practices. This role will work closely with vendors, enterprise business, and IT partners, utilizing industry-standard tools and best practices to ensure successful project completion. The position will be expected to escalate high-priority issues appropriately and in a timely manner. As a Senior Project Manager, the individual is responsible for ensuring project success across quality, financial performance, and customer delivery.

Essential Job Functions:

Define project engagement and obtain agreement on objectives, scope, timing, and resources.
Integrate stakeholder input that may include assisting in project prioritization, systems definition, and change management.
Develop and manage project plans, including tasks to deliver desired results, guide day-to-day work, and monitor progress toward milestones, holding the team accountable to the commitment.
Assist and direct the project team throughout the project lifecycle, removing impediments where feasible.
Identify, document, and track project risks, actions, and issues throughout the project lifecycle.
Consistently review the project dependencies and risks to ensure effective oversight across the relevant stakeholder groups.
Maintain and monitor project budget in comparison to project spend and assist with forecasting as needed.
Create, maintain, and distribute project documentation in compliance with the ORI IT SDLCS policy, EPMO standards, and Sarbanes-Oxley compliance.
Collect, compile, and review project artifacts for compliance in accordance with ORI IT SDLCS standards and Sarbanes-Oxley compliance.
Establish a communication plan and meeting cadence across the team to convey recent activity related to project milestones, risks, decisions, and next steps.
Maintain and publish meeting agendas and meeting minutes as well as weekly status reports on project activity, risks, decisions, budget, and next steps.
Coordinate internal and external project-related activities to ensure project tasks are completed on time, within budget, and within scope.
Report and escalate issues to management as needed to ensure project success.
Facilitate communication upward to the EPMO Director and other key stakeholders, including project status with explanations for variances in scope, timeline, and budget.
Work with stakeholders to ensure successful transitions among the project, implementation, and support teams.
Identify and apply continuous improvement methodologies throughout the project management lifecycle.
Perform project close-out steps that include a retrospective to identify and document lessons learned that may contribute to the success of future projects.
Assist EPMO leadership as needed to optimize project management standards while adhering to the ORI IT SDLCS policy, EPMO standards, and Sarbanes-Oxley compliance.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience.
7 or more years of proven work experience as a project manager in IT.

Deep understanding and adherence to formal project management methodologies.
Working knowledge of software development and change management processes.
Working knowledge of Sarbanes-Oxley compliance in IT and the insurance or finance industries.
Ability to prioritize and handle multiple projects in parallel.
Display advanced communication (verbal and written), attention to detail, organizational, analytical, critical thinking, and team-building skills.
Demonstrate advanced interpersonal, customer service, presentation, influencing, and relationship management skills.
Ability to work independently and/or as part of a team to meet established deadlines.
Knowledge of the insurance business process is preferred.

jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do.

At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits.

Responsibilities

The Market Intelligence (MI) team within the Keysight Corporate Strategy Office enables sustained corporate growth by equipping Keysight’s businesses with timely, accurate, and objective insights that drive revenue and profit growth, customer success, and brand loyalty.

A Keysight Market Intelligence Analyst accelerates and improves the quality of corporate strategic decisions by providing research, modeling, and analysis across Keysight’s industries, customers, and competitors. We work with partners across the company to facilitate and influence insights from the external market environment. Key contributions include Keysight’s strategic planning process, macroeconomic and geopolitical assessment, market modeling, growth opportunity assessments, executive and investor relations support, and ad hoc industry, customer and peer analysis. As the external environment continues to change, the job content is characterized as dynamic and thought-provoking.

Keysight SAM & TAM Market Scanning, Analysis and Modeling

Provide a consistent framework and process for creating and updating market models. Identify and track market, competitive, econometric, and industry trends and drivers.
Create thorough and objective financial models and projections
Coordinate, and collaborate with internal industry and solution partners to create consistent models of Keysight’s chosen market segments

Macroeconomic, Industry, Customer, and Peer Analysis

Provide quarterly reporting deliverables, including revenue narratives and market news to support earnings calls
Research market segments, analyze technology trends and customer performance, and monitor and synthesize peer performance
Provide market share performance analysis for Keysight and its key peers, including sub-segment and regional analysis where available

Strategic Consulting

Maintain always-ready market and scenario trackers to support rapid, ad hoc requests from CEO and CSO leadership
Deliver objective analysis of an opportunity space, including market and competitive dynamics, using Keysight standard strategy tools
Identify attributes of a differentiated, sustainable business model, and facilitate value-creation strategy development
Deliver balanced scenario analysis and recommendations to an executive audience while documenting key findings and sources

Modernization of Tools and Processes

Apply AI and automation (e.g., LLM-based agents, automated data pipelines) to streamline research, data gathering, market modeling, and reporting workflows)
Use AI-assisted analysis, visualization, and writing tools to elevate the impact and polish of executive deliverables

Qualifications

Expertise:

Understanding growth drivers and dynamics in the automotive, energy, industrial, and semiconductor industries. Familiarity with wireless and wireline telecommunications and aerospace/defense industries.
Knowledge of the economy, financial concepts, corporate accounting, and investor-relations fluency
Skilled in applying AI and automation tools to accelerate research, elevate deliverable quality, and safeguard data integrity
Working knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals

Strategic

Demonstrated ability to quickly acquire an in-depth knowledge of customer, market, competitive, business, and technology situation and integrate it into strategies that deliver sustainable competitive advantage
Demonstrated ability and experience networking with, and quickly mobilizing, key individuals inside and outside the organization to drive strategic dialog and decisions

Process

Demonstrated ability to create and facilitate processes across distributed organizations
Able to triage ambiguous, time-sensitive requests and deliver rigorous analysis on compressed timelines
Skilled in analyzing and summarizing market research and using strategic frameworks
Working proficiency with data and automation tools to build scalable, repeatable models and dashboards (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, MicroStrategy, Spotfire, Python, Salesforce)
Must be able to effectively communicate orally and in writing on business, strategy, technical, product, and solution issues and tailor to all levels of organization

People

Demonstrated ability to lead, motivate, and influence individuals and teams
Demonstrated ability to confidently brief senior executives and field real-time follow-up questions, virtually and in person.
Demonstrated ability to work cross-organizationally, form and nurture strong teams, and have a reputation as a collaborative team player

Personal

Demonstrated growth mindset including innate curiosity and eagerness to explore new topics and share learnings
Demonstrated ability to work in areas of high ambiguity with limited information
Demonstrated judgment to make sound business decisions and handle confidential, market-sensitive information appropriately
Energy, enthusiasm, and motivation that excites the same in others

Candidate should have an MBA or minimum 5 years of work experience in market intelligence, business intelligence, business analytics, strategy, corporate development, economics, or finance. An engineering degree (or technical equivalent) is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Singularity is an aerospace and defense startup headquartered in Gardena, CA. Our founding team hails from SpaceX, Anduril, and Lockheed Martin, and we are backed by Joint Staff-level military leadership and several Silicon Valley firms. Our first product is a low-cost air defense system built for immediate deployment worldwide. With a world-class business development and leadership team already in place, we are well positioned to capitalize on already overwhelming demand.

About The Role

We are looking for a Program Manager to help lead execution of fast-paced U.S. military and FMS programs involving tactical counter-air, integrated fires, and command-and-control integration. Reporting to the Director of Program Management, you will own the day-to-day program controls that turn contract scope, technical baselines, test plans, customer commitments, and business priorities into an executable plan. The position will be primarily aligned to U.S military programs while retaining the flexibility to support other FMS programs as they are awarded. This is a hands-on role for a disciplined leader who can manage cost, schedule, risk, deliverables, and cross-functional execution across multiple efforts without losing focus on the primary customer’s mission.

Key Responsibilities

Program Execution & Controls

Integrated Program Execution: Translate contracts, Other Transaction Authority agreements, Statements of Work, milestones, and technical requirements into an integrated master schedule, work breakdown structure, deliverable register, and near-term resource plan.
Cost, Schedule, & Risk: Maintain program execution baselines, track actuals and forecasts, identify cost and schedule variance, and drive mitigation or recovery plans before issues affect customer commitments.
Milestone Management: Plan and coordinate program reviews, payable milestone evidence, entrance and exit criteria, action closure, and Government acceptance packages.
Decision Discipline: Maintain decision, action, assumption, dependency, and risk registers so every major issue has an owner, due date, and documented impact to the baseline.
Multi-Program Support: Prioritize assigned programs while applying scalable program-management processes to other awarded efforts based on company needs and leadership direction.

Cross-Functional Integration

Integrated Product Team Leadership: Coordinate engineering, test, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, contracts, finance, configuration management, logistics, and business operations across a deliverable-based IPT structure.
Technical & Test Alignment: Partner with engineering and test leadership to keep requirements, interfaces, design maturity, manufacturing readiness, range planning, safety, verification evidence, and schedule synchronized.
C2 & System Integration Coordination: Support planning and execution for sensor, command-and-control, fire-control, launcher, interceptor, tactical data link, and external network interfaces, including Government and industry dependencies.
Supplier & Subcontractor Execution: Support subcontract planning, statements of work, purchase priorities, delivery tracking, and recovery actions for critical hardware, software, and services.
Configuration & Deliverable Control: Ensure baseline changes, customer direction, technical data, and contract artifacts are captured, reviewed, approved, and traceable.

Customer & Contract Interface

Customer Coordination: Serve as a principal day-to-day program interface with customer program, technical, contracting, test, range, and operational stakeholders; prepare clear status, decision, and issue packages.
Additional Program Support: Build and maintain credibility with other Government stakeholders when assigned to support active or newly awarded programs.
Contract Execution: Work with contracts, finance, and technical leads to align execution with contract terms, milestones, data rights, reporting requirements, and acceptance criteria.
Government Dependencies: Track Government-furnished information, equipment, facilities, range access, platform or network interfaces, approvals, and other dependencies required for execution and testing.
Executive Reporting: Provide concise, decision-ready updates covering progress, forecast, risks, financial status, dependencies, and recommended actions.

Basic Qualifications

8+ years of experience managing complex defense, aerospace, missile, integrated fires, command-and-control, autonomy, maritime, or similarly hardware-intensive development programs
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, program management, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
Experience managing cost, schedule, risk, requirements, deliverables, and cross-functional execution on a U.S. Department of War contract or prototype effort
Hands-on experience building and maintaining integrated master schedules, work breakdown structures, risk registers, program review materials, and executive-level status reporting
Experience coordinating engineering development, hardware manufacturing, software integration, test planning, and supplier execution within an aggressive schedule
Working knowledge of Department of War acquisition and contracting processes, including Statements of Work, CDRLs or equivalent deliverables, Government-furnished property or information, and formal review gates
Ability to convert ambiguous customer objectives into clear work packages, accountable owners, measurable completion criteria, and executable near-term priorities
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief senior Government, military, and company leaders with clarity and credibility
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance as required
Ability to travel approximately 15% to customer sites, integration facilities, suppliers, military ranges, and test events as program execution requires

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong adjacent program-management and system-integration experience are encouraged to apply.

Direct experience supporting U.S Military Program Executive Offices or Project Management Office, particularly PAE Fires or Missile Defense Agency
Familiarity with the PAE Fires portfolio and the Army integrated fires enterprise, including engagement with PAE Fires or related program, engineering, and integration organizations
Working knowledge of Integrated Battle Command System (IBCS), Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD), or comparable joint or service command-and-control and fire-control architectures
Experience coordinating C2 integration involving sensors, tactical data links, engagement planning, fire-control functions, launchers, interceptors, or external networks
Understanding of Army air defense, counter-unmanned aircraft systems, indirect fire protection, or integrated fires mission areas
Experience with Army or joint test organizations, operational demonstrations, range coordination, safety approvals, and verification or acceptance evidence
Experience executing prototype Other Transaction Authority agreements, including payable milestones, evidence packages, modifications, and Government acceptance
Experience managing concurrent development, qualification, manufacturing, software integration, ground test, flight test, and demonstration activities
Experience with configuration management, earned value or equivalent performance measurement, supply-chain risk, and production readiness
Direct experience as a Deputy Program Manager, Program Manager, IPT Lead, or Program Controls Lead in a defense environment
PMP, DAWIA, or equivalent program-management or acquisition certification
Active or recently active U.S. Secret clearance or higher
Experience supporting a non-traditional defense contractor or high-growth defense technology company

Compensation

Salary: $175,000 – $225,000

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Technical Program Manager, CUDA Robotics
new_jobs.description:
NVIDIA is seeking an experienced Senior Software Technical Program Manager to lead sophisticated software and platform programs spanning NVIDIA CUDA Robotics, accelerated computing and Physical AI! You will translate product and technology roadmaps into executable plans, establish achievements and ownership, lead multi-functional dependencies and risks, and drive programs from development through integration, validation, release, and ecosystem adoption. You will work across Product Management, Software and Hardware Engineering, Research, Quality Assurance, DevRel, Marketing, Legal, Customer Program Management, Solution Architects and external partners!

What You Will Be Doing

Collaborating closely with Software Development Managers, Engineers, Product Marketing, Customer Program Management, Solution Architects, Quality Assurance, and other logistics personnel to establish and implement streamlined processes for the development of advanced Compute software solutions for CSPs, OEMs, customers and partners.
Taking the lead in Physical AI initiatives involving CUDA software, Aerial software, GPU platforms, AI frameworks, inference, simulation, sensor processing, and developer ecosystems.
Scheduling and leading status meetings, proactively addressing challenges, addressing customer concerns, and serving as the central point of contact for building and upholding release schedules and the prioritized release plan of record.
Partnering with multi-functional teams throughout the company to strategically plan and drive software objectives for the team. In this role, you will collect requirements, help define priorities, remove blockers, drive planning and scheduling for all phases of the software development lifecycle.
Developing and maintaining integrated plans across multiple engineering workstreams, identifying critical-path dependencies, proactively identifying risks and formulating risk management strategies and driving teams toward commitments.
Taking the lead in enhancing existing product development and software release processes, while collaborating with engineering management to optimize the development workflow for maximum engineering efficiency. You will have the opportunity to partner with diverse technical groups, spanning all organizational levels.
Internally translating customer requirements into actionable tasks, ensuring customers are continually abreast about issue statuses. Drive Virtual reviews and establish a close feedback loop by communicating benchmarking results and customer insights to product and engineering leadership.
Collaborating with various internal teams and third-party partners across different time zones, as necessary, to resolve customer issues and supervise customer releases. Track and report large-scale performance benchmarking across all clusters. Build performance dashboards and reporting processes to monitor critical metrics and surface performance trends.

What We Need To See

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of proven experience in technical program management, software engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical role.
Hands on experience with software development for hardware platforms or communication runtime or high performance networking with demonstrated success in delivering complex products to customers.
Proficiency in Agile software development methodologies and tools.
Ability to work independently and actively with minimal guidance.
Confirmed experience to creatively resolve technical and resource issues. Ability to think strategically and tactically and to build consensus to ensure program success
Comprehensive understanding of software engineering principles, including experience with widely-adopted configuration management tools and productivity-enhancing tools and automation processes.
Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated capacity for multitasking, in a dynamic environment with shifting priorities and changing requirements.
Proven ability to resolve technical, schedule, resource, and organizational issues through influence and structured decision-making.
Strong communication and technical presentation skills.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Background with NVIDIA CUDA, Aerial, AI-RAN, 5G/6G, software-defined RAN, accelerated networking, or telecom platforms.
Experience with GPU-accelerated software, AI/ML frameworks, or NVIDIA GPU platforms, including familiarity with Physical AI, autonomous systems, simulation, perception, inference, or multimodal sensor pipelines.
Experience delivering SDKs, reference architectures, developer platforms, datasets, simulation environments, or digital twins.
Experience leading customer and partner programs involving platform bring-up, proof-of-concepts, benchmarking, and production releases.
MBA/PMP certification or training is a plus.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

168,000 USD – 258,750 USD for Level 4; and 200,000 USD – 322,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 13, 2026.

1. Project planning and execution
· Lead end-to-end planning and execution of large-scale SD-WAN and network infrastructure rollout programs across multiple sites and locations

2. Technology and infrastructure delivery
· Mange delivery of SD-WAN, network modernisation and associated infrastructure deployment activities
· Coordinate network design readiness, procurement, site assessments, connectivity provisioning, configuration, testing, migration and cutover activities
· Manage rollout risks, operational impacts, service continuity, outages, change windows and implementation constraints

· Drive project governance forums, vendor forums, technical working groups and manage stakeholder updates
· Establish clear go/no-go criteria and ensure deployments are executed within approved maintenance windows
· Coordinate post-implementation validation, service acceptance and transition to operational support
· Ensure successful deployment, service acceptance, operational handover and closure across all locations

3. Stakeholder, vendor and team management
· Act as the primary point of contact for network vendors, service providers, network architects, infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to manage dependencies and implementation readiness
· Lead and coordinate geographically distributed, cross-functional and offshore delivery teams
· Build effective relationships with hospital and aged care operational stakeholders, site representatives, project sponsors and technology leaders
· Proactively manage expectations, resolve conflicts and drive timely decisions

4. Financial and commercial management
· Own project financial management, including budgets, forecasts, actuals, resource costs and financial reporting
· Track vendor expenditure, purchase orders, invoices, commercial commitments and budget variances
· Coordinate procurement, statements of work, change requests and vendor commercial matters
· Identify financial and resource risks and implement appropriate corrective actions
· Ensure delivery remains within approved budgets and resource allocations

5. Governance, reporting and PMO management
· Maintain project governance in accordance with established PMO frameworks, methodologies and reporting requirements
· Own project budgets, forecasts, vendor commitments, purchase orders and financial reporting
· Maintain project governance, RAID registers, schedules and status reporting through PMO365
· Prepare executive updates, milestone reports and governance packs
· Escalate material risks, delays, operational impacts and decisions requiring sponsor or SteerCo intervention
· Ensure appropriate approvals and governance checkpoints are completed throughout the project lifecycle

6. Risk, quality and delivery assurance
· Proactively identify, assess and manage delivery risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and constraints
· Manage risks associated to site readiness, connectivity, planned outages, operational disruption and service continuity
· Ensure appropriate contingency, rollback and business continuity arrangements are established for critical deployment activities
· Monitor project quality, deliverables, acceptance criteria and adherence to agreed standards
· Coordinate testing, deployment readiness, implementation approvals and operational handover
· Drive project closure, lessons learned and continuous improvement to effectively improve the subsequent stages of rollout and future deployments

· Project documents, delivery plans, schedules and charters

· Site readiness assessments, downtime agreements and implementation approvals
· Vendor delivery plans and performance tracking
· Project budgets, forecasts and financial variance reports
· RAID logs, dependency registers and change control documentation
· PMO365 updates, governance reports and SteerCo packs
· Network migration, cutover, contingency and rollout plans
